title: Twin Reunion
next_chapter_hook: At the moment when Chen Ji believed everything was under control, Chen Ling's voice suddenly carried an unprecedented gravity—the death prophecy of Chapter 700 had indeed been altered, but a new, more terrifying prophecy was quietly taking shape in the depths of fate.

text.content: In the hall, the atmosphere froze like ice. The imperial emissary wore a black official robe, a Heavenly Sovereign Sword at his waist, his aura as heavy as mountains; the demonic path commander was draped in black纱 concealing their face, a dark red demonic mark flickering between their brows, as if ready to transform into an abyss devouring all. The tension between both sides was palpable, and the air crackled with volatile energy. Yet Chen Ji remained seated at the main seat, fingers drumming lightly on the armrest, his knowing smile deepening instead of fading. But just as everyone anticipated the spectacle to unfold, Chen Ji's body suddenly stiffened.

A unprecedented power exploded from deep within Chen Ji's brow center, like massive waves surging from an ancient well sealed for a millennium. This force did not originate from the Tianji Record, but from an even more hidden, more ancient corner—where another soul connected to his bloodline had slumbered all along. Chen Ji felt his vision blur, and in the next instant, his consciousness was pulled into a vast void. All around was endless chaos and darkness, except straight ahead, where a slender figure was slowly taking form.

dialogue.content: (A gentle voice yet carrying a thousand years of vicissitudes) Brother... you've finally arrived. I've waited for this day for an incredibly long time.

text.content: The figure gradually became clear—it was a young woman bearing a striking resemblance to Chen Ji, sharing seven parts of his features. She wore a plain white long dress, surrounded by soft silver light, resembling a celestial being emerging from the river of fate. However, her eyes were hollow and grey, as if bearing an unbearable weight. Chen Ji gazed at this familiar yet unfamiliar face, when a long-sealed memory in his mind was suddenly torn open—long ago, when he was merely a child, he had encountered a girl of the same age in the family's forbidden grounds. That girl had told him: "We are twins, and destiny has bound us together long ago."

dialogue.content: (Chen Ling softly said) Brother, you remember me. I'm happy. After a thousand years of slumber, what I feared most was being forgotten by you. But this is not the time for sorrow. Brother, you must know a truth—about the Tianji Record, about your ability, about yourself... (Chen Ling's voice suddenly grew grave) The true source of that ability does not lie in the Tianji Record, but in me.

text.content: Upon hearing this, Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. He had always believed the Tianji Record was a precious artifact left by ancient powerful beings, a turning point in his fate, and the foundation of his flawless calculations. Yet now, this existence claiming to be his twin sister was asserting that this heaven-defying foresight ability originated from her. Chen Ling seemed to perceive his doubt, gently raising her hand, and a blurry image materialized in the void—a vast, boundless river of fate reflecting countless intertwined threads, each representing a person's destiny.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ling gazed at those threads) Within the river of fate, there exists an extremely special being—the "Twin Fate Bearer." Our souls were originally one, but destiny forcibly split them in two. One half carries the power of "writing," capable of rewriting the trajectory of fate; the other half bears the power of "observation," able to glimpse fate's direction. Brother, the page of the Tianji Record you obtained should originally have been part of my soul.

text.content: Chen Ji stared intently at those intertwined threads, his heart shaken like tumultuous waves. He had always believed he was the fortunate one chosen by the Tianji Record, never expecting that behind such luck lay such a heavy price. Chen Ling's form trembled slightly, as if maintaining this state had already exhausted much of her power. Yet she persisted, continuing to narrate that tale sealed in the past. In those days, the clan had sealed her together with the Tianji Record deep within the forbidden grounds to protect her. As for Chen Ji, he was specifically sent out of the clan, surviving until now as atrash at the Tianqing Sect. All of this was to conceal her existence, preventing those coveting the "Twin Fate" from finding her.

choice.prompt: Confronted with this sudden truth, Chen Ji had to make a choice. How should he face this twin sister separated for a thousand years?

choices.description: Acknowledge Chen Ling's existence, willing to face fate together with her, joining hands to oppose the Eye of Heavenly Dao
choices.visible_reward: Gain Chen Ling's complete trust, unlock the "Twin Resonance" ability
choices.risk_hint: The fates of both will be completely bound, sharing prosperity and decline together

text.content: Chen Ji remained silent for a long while, then slowly extended his hand, gently grasping Chen Ling's ethereal fingers. In that instant, a warm force flowed from his palm, as if crossing a thousand-year river of time, tightly connecting two lonely souls. Chen Ling's eyes instantly reddened, a thousand years of waiting, loneliness, and fear transforming into scalding tears in this moment. (Chen Ling said with a choking voice) Brother... thank you...

choices.memory_label: 接纳双生妹妹陈灵，共同对抗命运

choices.description: Understand Chen Ling's circumstances, but insist on fighting separately, avoiding excessive binding of fate
choices.visible_cost: May lose Chen Ling's crucial assistance
choices.visible_reward: Maintain strategic flexibility, have more room for choices in the future
choices.risk_hint: Chen Ling might be disappointed, but it won't affect the fundamental relationship

text.content: Chen Ji gently shook his head, his tone gentle yet resolute. (Chen Ji said deeply) Chen Ling, I'm delighted to have found you. But I'm accustomed to traveling the world alone, and I don't want anyone to risk danger because of me. You just need to assist me from the shadows; other matters, I'll handle myself. Chen Ling was stunned for a moment, then revealed a relieved smile. She understood her brother's kind intentions and respected his choice. (Chen Ling softly said) Very well, brother. I will watch over you from here. When you truly need me, I will appear.

choices.memory_label: 与陈灵保持独立合作关系

choices.description: Attempt to fuse the powers of two people into one, creating entirely new possibilities.
choices.visible_cost: The process is dangerous and may cause temporary confusion of consciousness.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain an unprecedented 'Fate Co-Writing' ability, allowing one to write the future simultaneously with Chen Ling.
choices.risk_hint: If it fails, the consciousness of both individuals may be permanently damaged.

text.content:
A resolute gleam flickered in Chen Ji's eyes. He was never one to accept mediocrity. Since fate had granted him such a remarkable sister, why not push this extraordinary opportunity to its ultimate extreme?

(Chen Ji said in a low voice) Chen Ling, what would happen if we fused our powers?

Chen Ling hesitated, then immediately grasped his meaning. A flash of astonishment crossed her eyes, quickly transforming into intense emotion and anticipation.

(Chen Ling whispered) That would be the true 'Fate Co-Writing'. We could write the future together, adding countless possibilities to fate's trajectory.

But this path is dangerous, brother...

(Chen Ji smiled faintly) When has Chen Ji ever feared danger?

choices.memory_label: 与陈灵完成灵魂融合，获得命运共笔能力

text.content:
No matter what choice Chen Ji made, Chen Ling's face revealed a sense of relief and joy. A thousand years of waiting finally found its perfect conclusion in this moment.

She gently raised her hand, and another vision materialized in the void—a blurred figure surrounded by eerie golden light, gazing down upon all under heaven.

(Chen Ling's voice turned grave) Brother, do you see it? That is the Eye of Heavenly Providence. It is not a concrete entity, but a transcendent consciousness. It treats every generation of prophets as mere chess pieces, and the Tianji Record is just one of its many pieces placed in the mortal realm.

And we twin fated ones, are the existence it most desperately seeks to obtain and most wants to destroy.

dialogue.content:
(Chen Ling gazed at that golden figure) All these years, I have been observing it in secret.

I discovered certain patterns— whenever a prophet awakens, it intervenes; whenever fate's trajectory threatens to escape its control, it unleashes catastrophe.

Brother, every step of your growth has been under its watchful gaze.

(Chen Ling's voice carried a hint of worry) But it is not invincible. It has a fatal weakness—it cannot directly intervene in destiny, only manipulating through guidance and suggestion.

As long as we are strong enough, determined enough, it can never truly bind us.

text.content:
As Chen Ji listened to Chen Ling's account, his understanding of the Eye of Heavenly Providence finally took on a clear outline. This ultimate nemesis was not a specific enemy, but an existence transcending all. It had no form yet existed everywhere; it could not die yet could be weakened.

This was more troublesome than any opponent he had faced before. But simultaneously, it showed him the dawn of victory.

Chen Ling seemed to sense the change in his heart and gently grasped his hand.

(Chen Ling said softly) Brother, don't worry. No matter how difficult the road ahead, I will be by your side.

When you truly need me, I will give you decisive assistance.

This is not empty talk—it is fate's promise to twin souls.

dialogue.content:
(Chen Ling's voice suddenly carried a grave tone) But brother, there is something I must tell you.

I know you have been searching for me—the death prophecy in Chapter 700, I have been paying close attention to it.

That prophecy... it has indeed been altered. You were originally supposed to die in that catastrophe, but because our bloodlines are connected, my existence disrupted fate's trajectory, allowing you to escape death.

(Chen Ling sighed softly) However, a new prophecy is forming.

This time, it is even more terrifying. Because this time, fate has drawn both of us into its chess game.

text.content:
Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly. He remembered the death prophecy in Chapter 700 clearly—it was the first time he truly felt death approaching, and the first time he realized how heavy the price of the Tianji Record was. If not for that vague blank in his fate, he would have long since turned to dust.

Now Chen Ling told him that death prophecy had indeed been altered. What did this mean? Did it mean his fate could indeed be rewritten by himself? Or did it mean an even greater crisis was brewing?

Chen Ling seemed to sense his confusion and gently shook her head.

(Chen Ling whispered) Don't try to foresee that new prophecy. Before you are strong enough, any premature glimpse may accelerate its arrival.

Trust me, brother. We are twins, fate has long bound us together. I won't let you face those things alone.

choice.prompt: A new prophecy is taking shape, and Chen Ling's words seem to hide even more information. How should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Although Chen Ling advised against premature foresight, as a man of meticulous planning, Chen Ji must grasp as much information as possible.
choices.visible_cost: May put pressure on Chen Ling
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more clues about the new prophecy
choices.risk_hint: Chen Ling may hold back certain information

text.content:
After a moment of contemplation, Chen Ji still spoke up.

(Chen Ji said calmly) Chen Ling, it is not that I don't trust you. But as your brother, I must know more.

What exactly is that new prophecy? Even just a vague outline would be better than fumbling in darkness.

Chen Ling fell silent for a moment, as if weighing something. Finally, she nodded gently.

(Chen Ling said in a low voice) Very well, brother. Since you insist...

The core of the new prophecy is a 'Heavenly Punishment'. And the target of this punishment is precisely us, the twin fated ones.

choices.description: Since fate has become a chess game, might as well face it calmly and focus energy on what can be done in the present.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain a stable mindset, avoid letting prophecies influence judgment.
choices.risk_hint: Sometimes knowing too little is also a kind of danger.

text.content:
Chen Ji smiled faintly, his expression revealing a tranquil insight into worldly affairs.

(Chen Ji said calmly) Chen Ling, since a new prophecy is taking shape, then let it take shape.

From being atrash to today, which step of my Chen Ji's life wasn't walked through the midst of desperate straits?

When the enemy comes, we send generals; when water arrives, we build banks. Rather than worry about things that haven't happened yet, better to do well what lies before us.

Chen Ling was stunned for a moment, then revealed a relieved smile. She suddenly understood why fate chose her brother to be the one carrying the Tianji Record.

(Chen Ling whispered) Brother, you are indeed stronger than I imagined. Very well, I won't say more. Each of us fulfills our duty, waiting quietly for the right moment.

choices.memory_label: 决定顺其自然，坦然面对命运

text.content:
While Chen Ji and Chen Ling communicated in the depths of consciousness, time in the outside world seemed to freeze. The imperial emissary and the demonic commander still maintained their combative posture, the atmosphere in the dojo still heavy as ice.

Yet Chen Ji was no longer the Chen Ji of a moment ago.

Deep within his brow center, there now existed a soul connected by blood; on his fate's chessboard, there was now a crucial piece; on his path ahead, there was now a promise from a thousand years ago.

Chen Ling's form began to fade gradually, a thousand years of slumber having exhausted too much of her strength. But just before vanishing, her voice rang out once more, carrying unprecedented resolve.

dialogue.content:
(Chen Ling's voice faded into the distance, yet every word remained clear)

Brother, remember—

No matter how powerful the Eye of Heavenly Providence may be, it is ultimately merely an observer of fate. And you and I, we are the masters of destiny.

When you truly need me, call my name. I will tear open a sliver of opportunity in fate's crevices for you.

Farewell, brother. The next time we meet, I will show you the true me.

(Chen Ling's form completely dissipated, yet that warm power remained in the depths of Chen Ji's brow center, eternal and undying like a brand)

text.content:
Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes.

In the arena hall, everything remained unchanged. The Imperial Court emissary and the Demonic Path commander still faced each other in confrontation, both sides' forces still locked in tense standoff. Yet, Chen Ji's perspective on all this had become entirely different.

He gently touched his brow center, where a warm current of power was flowing slowly. That was the mark left by Chen Ling—a bond of a thousand-year bloodline, one of his greatest trump cards in this chaotic world.

A faint, confident smile played at the corner of his lips as he rose. His voice was soft yet carried clearly throughout the entire arena hall.

(Chen Ji said calmly) Esteemed guests, why must we be so confrontational?

Surely we can discuss this like civilized people, don't you think?

choice.prompt: Facing this restored standoff, how should Chen Ji act with his newly acquired power and information?

choices.description: Navigate between the two factions using newly acquired information and insight, seeking maximum benefit
choices.visible_cost: Requires expending energy to maintain balance
choices.visible_reward: Gain favor from both the Imperial Court and the Demonic Path simultaneously, with reputation soaring
choices.risk_hint: Either side may see through his intentions

text.content:
Chen Ji descended from the main seat with measured steps, his pace neither hurried nor slow, as if the tense confrontation before him were merely an insignificant side note.

His gaze first fell upon the Imperial Court emissary, a faint smile appearing.

(Chen Ji said calmly) Your Excellency has traveled a long way. Surely you didn't come merely to exchange harsh words with those of the Demonic Path?

Then he turned to the Demonic Path commander, his tone carrying added depth.

(Chen Ji said lightly) The same must apply to you, Commander. Tianqing Sect's humble halls cannot accommodate such grand displays of force from both distinguished guests. Why not grant Chen this one favor and each take a step back?

At these words, both factions faltered. When did thistrash disciple gain such magnificent presence?

choices.memory_label: 尝试居中调停皇朝与魔道的冲突

choices.description: Let both sides fight first while observing secretly, gathering intelligence
choices.visible_reward: See through both factions' trump cards, providing leverage for future scheming
choices.risk_hint: May miss out on immediate benefits

text.content:
Chen Ji settled back into the main seat, his posture leisurely, as if everything before him had nothing to do with him.

He lifted his teacup, took a light sip, while his gaze不经意ly swept over everyone present.

Among the Imperial Court emissary's guards, one person's aura differed from the rest—a suppressed sharpness, like a blade hidden in its sheath.

And behind the Demonic Path commander, there was also a gaze that drew his particular attention. It was an seemingly ordinary Demonic Path disciple, yet Chen Ji saw something familiar in that person's eyes.

That was... ambition.

(Chen Ji muttered in his heart) Interesting. These two factions are probably far more complicated than they appear.

choices.memory_label: 暗中观察两方人马，发现隐藏情报

text.content:
Just as Chen Ji contemplated his next move, a voice—elderly yet full of vitality—suddenly echoed from outside the arena hall.

(The newcomer's voice) Hahahaha! I've arrived at precisely the right moment!

Everyone turned to look, and there stood an elderly man in a blue robe slowly walking into the arena hall. He appeared utterly ordinary, like any common old man. But the moment Chen Ji saw him, his pupils constricted.

The visitor was no other than Tianqing Sect's former Sect Master—Ling Yuan.

That old fox who ostensibly protected him while harboring treacherous intentions.

Ling Yuan's gaze swept across the arena hall before landing on Chen Ji, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his lips.

(Ling Yuan laughed) Chen Ji, I heard things were lively here, so I特意 came to take a look.怎么，不欢迎老夫？

dialogue.content:
(Ling Yuan walked closer slowly, his gaze profound like an abyss)

Two distinguished guests gracing Tianqing Sect simultaneously—this is indeed a rare spectacle not seen in many years.

(Ling Yuan's tone carried playful undertones) However, since this old man has arrived, perhaps the mediation should be left to me to decide?

Chen Ji, I know you possess some abilities, but certain matters remain beyond what someone at your level should meddle with.

(Ling Yuan's words seemingly offered Chen Ji a way out, but in reality were publicly undermining his authority)

text.content:
Chen Ji gazed at Ling Yuan's benevolent-seeming expression, but internally cold laughter surged. This old fox had chosen this precise moment to appear, clearly having come fully prepared.

He had just completed consciousness communion with Chen Ling and gained new power and perception. Faced with Ling Yuan's public suppression, he could have easily counterattacked—with his current insight, every trap hidden in Ling Yuan's words was crystal clear.

But he didn't.

Chen Ji rose and gave Ling Yuan a slight bow, his manner respectfully impeccable.

(Chen Ji said respectfully) Disciple Chen Ji greets the Sect Master Ancestor. The Ancestor speaks truly—I am young and shallow, indeed should not presume to show off my limited abilities here.

Ling Yuan hesitated momentarily, clearly not expecting Chen Ji to concede so easily. But his smile quickly returned to normal, and he was about to speak when Chen Ji continued—

(Chen Ji turned the conversation) However, this disciple dares to ask—what does the Ancestor intend to do about mediating this dispute?

(Chen Ji's tone was humble, but his gaze sharp as a blade) Though young, this disciple also wishes to learn.

Ling Yuan's smile froze for an instant.

When had thistrash disciple become so difficult to deal with? He had thought that by suppressing Chen Ji publicly, he could seize control of the arena hall, but hadn't expected the other party to nonchalantly kick the ball right back.

More troublesome was—he truly didn't know how to answer this question.

The Imperial Court emissary represented the Son of Heaven, the Demonic Path commander represented the Holy Sect—he couldn't afford to offend either faction. The so-called "mediation" was merely a pretense.

Chen Ji watched Ling Yuan's ugly expression, but his heart remained unruffled.

He wanted to suppress him publicly?

Then let him taste the滋味 of having the tables turned.

The atmosphere in the arena hall grew subtly tense once more. The Imperial Court emissary and the Demonic Path commander exchanged glances, both seeing a hint of amusement in the other's eyes. Thistrash disciple seemed far more interesting than the rumors suggested.

dialogue.content:
Just as the atmosphere僵持, a faint fluctuation suddenly pulsed from deep within Chen Ji's brow center—the mark left by Chen Ling was transmitting some kind of message to him.

Chen Ji closed his eyes briefly, and next moment, a blurry image materialized in his mind.

It was a woman's back, standing amidst heavy mist. Around her were countless threads of fate, each one trembling frantically.

And deep within that mist, a pair of golden eyes slowly opened.

(Chen Ling's voice transmitted from the depths of consciousness, weak yet urgent) Brother... I sense it... it has noticed us...

That new prophecy... has already begun to take shape...

(Chen Ling's voice grew increasingly faint) Be careful... the Heavenly... Dao's Eye...

text.content:
Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes.

In his pupils, a complex emotion flickered briefly before vanishing. The information Chen Ling transmitted was blurry, but its warning was unmistakably clear—the Heavenly Dao's Eye had sensed their communion, and a new crisis was approaching at a speed beyond his foresight.

But his face showed no trace of panic.

Instead, a faint smile curved at his lips.

Fate's twin spirits of a thousand years ago, reunited today after a millennium.

The Heavenly Dao's Eye wished to destroy them?

Then let it come.

(Chen Ji said softly) Many thanks for the Ancestor's concern. However, the matter of mediation requires further deliberation.

Perhaps... this disciple may speak with both distinguished guests privately first?

At these words, Ling Yuan's expression shifted slightly. But the Imperial Court emissary and Demonic Path commander both simultaneously revealed amused smiles.

Thistrash disciple, it seemed, was not as simple as the rumors suggested.
